name: Paqlebot
description: Paqle's news crawler. It indexes news articles to discover who is mentioned in the media, crawling at most one page per minute per site and tuning its rate to how often a site publishes. Paqle documents that the crawler falls back to a site's Googlebot robots.txt rules when no Paqlebot rules are present, and that its addresses reverse-resolve under paqle.net.
